**Methods:**


| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `eat()` | Eats the given food using Inventory.interact(Filter, String) using getFilter() and either "Eat" or "Drink" as the action. |
| `eat(boolean overEat)` | See eat(int, boolean) using Skill.HITPOINTS 's Skill.getLevel() as the minimum health |
| `eat(int minHealth, boolean overEat)` | Checks for the best Food and eats it based on the minHealth and overEat parameters. |
| `getBestOnHand(boolean overEat)` | Gets the best Food in your Inventory based on if you pass in true/false for over eating. |
| `getFilter()` | Gets a Filter to match a non-null, non-noted non-placeholder Item that matches the current Food |
| `getFromInventory()` | Gets an existing Item from your Inventory that matches getFilter() |
| `toString()` | Returns the proper name without _'s and proper casing. |
| `valueOf(String name)` | Returns the enum constant of this type with the specified name. |
| `values()` | Returns an array containing the constants of this enum type, in the order they are declared. |
